rows.jyutping: ngaam1 ngaam1 ceot1 sai3 ge3 N
rows.note: This is the all-purpose conversational choice for something that was just born, especially in an attributive phrase such as “啱啱出世嘅BB”.

example.english: The newborn baby is really cute.
example.traditional: 啱啱出世嘅嬰兒真係好得意。
example.jyutping: ngaam1 ngaam1 ceot1 sai3 ge3 jing1 ji4 zan1 hai6 hou2 dak1 ji3

rows.note: Use this compact adjective in established descriptions such as “初生BB” or “初生嬰兒”, rather than the fuller conversational construction.

example.english: Newborn babies need to be fed regularly.
example.jyutping: co1 sang1 jing1 ji4 jiu3 ding6 si4 wai3 naai5
